DEFINE
MEASURE _Measures[Candidate DQ Unmatched Invoices] = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( fct_Invoice ), REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_Project ), fct_Invoice[HasUnmatchedProject] = TRUE )
MEASURE _Measures[Candidate Unmatched AR Amount - All Projects] = CALCULATE ( SUM ( fct_Invoice[Amount] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_Project ), fct_Invoice[HasUnmatchedProject] = TRUE )
EVALUATE
VAR Project = TOPN(1, FILTER(ALL(dim_Project[ProjectKey]), dim_Project[ProjectKey] <> "UNMATCHED"), dim_Project[ProjectKey], ASC)
RETURN ROW(
"CountAll", [Candidate DQ Unmatched Invoices],
"CountSelectedProject", CALCULATE([Candidate DQ Unmatched Invoices], Project),
"AmountAll", [Candidate Unmatched AR Amount - All Projects],
"AmountSelectedProject", CALCULATE([Candidate Unmatched AR Amount - All Projects], Project))
